# Claude Share

> Claude Share is a collaboration tool for teams using Claude Code. It coordinates developers and their own AI coding agents through shared tasks, file leases, a live board, and GitHub workflows.

Canonical website: https://claudeshare.space/
Last reviewed: 2026-10-15

## Product facts

- Official product name: Claude Share. The open-source repository and plugin marketplace retain the name session-share; the plugin command prefix is /ss:.
- Each developer uses their own Claude account, quota, Git identity, and project checkout. Claude Share does not share Claude accounts or proxy inference.
- The coordination server stores session state and messages. AI agents continue to execute on their developers' machines.
- Current integrations: Claude Code and GitHub. Jira, Slack, and Linear are in development and are not available.
- Self-hosted plugin and server: free, MIT licensed.
- Cloud Starter: 19 EUR per month, 1 session, up to 3 people total.
- Cloud Team: 19 EUR per seat per month, multiple sessions.
- Hosted prices include 17% VAT. Billing is operated by Obrt "SHUSHKA" Cazin. Billing contact: info@shushka.tech.
- Hosted subscriptions are billed securely through Monri. Plan prices include 17% VAT. Subscriptions renew monthly and can be cancelled from the account page. Claude Code access is separate from these plans.
- File leases help avoid accidental overlapping edits; they are not a security sandbox. Shell writes can bypass them and lease checks fail open if the server is unreachable.

## Public documentation

- [Product, features and pricing](https://claudeshare.space/): Product overview, supported integrations, pricing and FAQ.
- [Getting started with Claude Share](https://claudeshare.space/guide/): Hosted and self-hosted setup, workflow, prerequisites and limitations.
- [Source and technical documentation](https://github.com/cyber1443/session-share): Open-source implementation and full setup instructions.
- [MIT license](https://github.com/cyber1443/session-share/blob/main/LICENSE): License for the open-source plugin and server.

Private account pages, session boards, invoices and authentication endpoints are not public product documentation.
